findings.issue: Secret redaction occurs after JSON.stringify. JSON serialization escapes some characters in an opaque token, so the serialized text no longer contains the literal token that redact searches for. The accepted loader only requires a nonblank string and does not exclude such values. Thus the error-persistence invariant does not hold for all accepted credential strings. The same serialization order is used by runtime final-error persistence.
findings.reproduction: Executed actual core.run only, with in-memory synthetic transport/persistence and token SYNTHETIC-QUOTE-"-ONLY. validate succeeded; fake readApp threw Error('401 '+token); writeOnce was never called. run persisted operation-error.json into the in-memory array. JSON.parse(persistedText).message.includes(token) was true; [REDACTED] marker was absent. No runtime.mjs, loader, real SDK, credential path, network or actual filesystem persistence was involved in this control.
findings.impact: An opaque quote-bearing input or corresponding provider-error echo can be recoverably recorded in error evidence despite the declared redact-before-persistence guarantee. The current16offline cases use SYNTHETIC/token+only, which is not altered by JSON string escaping, and therefore miss this case. This is NOT a claim that a real Sanity token has this character set, that the synthetic string authenticates, or that any real credential has leaked. Even invalid accepted credential inputs must not be recoverably logged on the failure path.
findings.fix_direction: Have the authorized executor redact sensitive string values before JSON serialization, or implement and test equivalent serialization-aware redaction. Cover both core.save and runtime readback/final-error serializers rather than fixing only the reproduced branch. Add a synthetic quote/backslash/control-character roundtrip regression asserting parsed persisted errors/results contain no original token, while retaining raw/URI/base64 checks and zero-write/no-retry invariants. No real credential or cloud test required.
